g.text: A video frame's journey: flash to panel
Our own BCM2722 image (dev41) and host player; the PP keeps the audio and the clock, the BCM decodes and draws
a picture is shown when its successor's first slice arrives (or at EOS), so the host feeds one frame ahead.
power-cycle, boot of a ~93 KB image, first frame ≈ 0.61 s (0.37 s with the BCM already off) [silicon S30].
during a session the image owns the panel; host LCD updates are acknowledged without drawing [ours].
). [ours] = our protocol and image, not the chip.
